title: The Madoff Ponzi Scheme Explained Like You're 5
hook: He told investors their money grew ten percent a year, like clockwork -- for decades, nobody checked the math, and it turned out to be the largest fraud in Wall Street history.
body:
Bernie Madoff founded his own Wall Street firm in 1960 with $5,000 he saved as a lifeguard, built it into a respected market maker, and served three separate terms as non-executive chairman of the NASDAQ board. One floor below his real business, a walled-off unit of no more than 24 employees ran a completely different operation: an investment advisory arm promising a steady 10% return every year, backed by no real trades at all. New client money paid old clients' withdrawals -- the textbook Ponzi mechanism -- while fabricated statements, produced with the help of CFO Frank DiPascali and rubber-stamped by a three-person auditing firm, kept the illusion alive for decades. Financial analyst Harry Markopolos tried to replicate Madoff's returns in the late 1990s, concluded they were mathematically impossible, and sent the SEC six formal warnings between 1999 and 2008 -- all essentially ignored. The 2008 financial crisis triggered roughly $7 billion in redemption requests Madoff could not cover. On December 9, 2008, he confessed to his sons that the business was "one big lie"; they reported him the next day, and the FBI arrested him on December 11, 2008. He pleaded guilty to 11 felony counts on March 12, 2009, and was sentenced to 150 years in prison on June 29, 2009. This is what the SEC's and DOJ's own records, the FBI's case file, and the sentencing transcript say happened.

For educational and entertainment purposes. Historical events are dramatised; no dialogue in this video is presented as a verbatim quotation except where directly attributed on screen.

pinned: The part that still gets me: the fictitious value on client statements was $64.8 billion, but the real cash that ever existed and vanished was about $17.5 billion -- two very different "size of the fraud" numbers. Which one surprised you more?
